name: security-rat-modern
description: Modern Security Requirements Automation Tool - DeepWiki-first, deterministic, OWASP ASVS/SPVS focused

scripts.build: npm run clean:dist && npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist && find . -name 'dist' -type d -not -path './node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
